title: ID0419093-DC/Si-D/FR-[ MP / P5 170000510 ]  Error with  screen display
description:
Reported issue: It looks like the terminal on this charger is no longer working. The screen displays the following error: "Terminal candidate list empty." I also haven’t seen any transactions for quite some time. Based on similar cases we have encountered in the past, this is often due to a faulty CORA10. I have attached photos showing the error both on the logs and on the IHM, to help with the troubleshooting.

additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Customer reported issue with screen displaying error: "Terminal candidate list empty."
This is due to the Bad connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Check, if right ports are used to connect COR A10 to OPM-C60. (As per following)
Check cable connection between Processing Unit and Card Reader.
Re-connect cables and re-start charger.
After Troubleshooting, We need to consider replacing the COR A10.
If you need any further information, Feel Free to reach out to NOC Team.
